title: 1976 Hostess #13 Bobby Grich Baltimore Orioles Baseball Card
categoryName: Sports Mem, Cards & Fan Shop:Sports Trading Cards:Trading Card Singles
descriptionText: The product is a 1976 Hostess trading card featuring Bobby Grich of the Baltimore Orioles, who played second base in the MLB during the 1976 season. This baseball card is a part of the 1976 Hostess set and is a base variety card. The card, numbered 13, showcases the player in his Baltimore Orioles uniform, making it a collectible for fans of baseball memorabilia and trading cards.
